gold_review.explanation: Reward is a JudgeRubric LLM judge (gpt-4.1-mini via OPENAI_API_KEY) and the search tool needs OpenAI embeddings; with no judge everything is 0. [INFERENCE] judge_reward_func also calls the async judge_rubric.judge() without await and does .lower() on the coroutine, which would fail even with a judge.
gold_review.evidence: quality_ds_search.py:17-19,138-151 JudgeRubric + judge_reward_func; :144-145 `judge_response = judge_rubric.judge(...)` (no await) then `.lower()`; gold_raw.log judge_reward_func r1=[0.0]*5
